message.reasoning_content: We need to determine criminal charges based on facts. Facts: civil judgment for compensation. Defendant failed to comply with enforcement notice, did not report assets, was judicially detained (i.e., enforcement detention). Then later complied and got forgiveness. The conduct is refusal to comply with enforcement order, which is a criminal offense under Chinese law: "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" (refusal to execute judgment). The statutory name is "拒不执行判决、裁定". According to correction rule: list only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we output "拒不执行判决、裁定". No other crimes. So final answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>.
